Container.Name: bord-food-api
Container.Overview: Local USDA FoodData Central search and details for Bòrd. Read API and supervised bulk worker. Starts empty and publishes immutable catalogs; crawling and paid sources remain disabled.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Host port for the local food API

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and downloaded ZIPs; must be writable by UID 99/GID 100

Config.Name: Supplied datasets
Config.Description: Optional USDA JSON or JSON ZIP files

Config.Name: Automatic USDA acquisition
Config.Description: Enable automatic USDA bootstrap and updates; explicit false preserves local-only USDA use

Config.Name: Optional source policy
Config.Description: Optional policy JSON path inside the container, for example /data/policy.json; blank uses bulk-only core defaults

Config.Name: Optional API key
Config.Description: Blank disables auth. If set, configure the same value as USDA_FDC_API_KEY on Bòrd.
